scope: Automatic NDI startup in the Windows x64 app layout using a fresh profile. The Media fixture verified the app-local runtime module path.

media.observed: Medias Add offered NDI. Auto selected the exact external sender, installed its 320x240 native preview, and loaded the DLL from the application's ndi directory. No activation or sender-selection action was needed.

screen.observed: Choosing NDI on an enabled Screen published 320x240 at 30 FPS immediately. A separate receiver verified output color and routed audio with the editors closed. After MapGyver exited and restarted, opening the saved project restored the same sender, green picture and 880/440 Hz routes with channel 2 silent and physical output disabled. Removing the Screen withdrew its sender.

mediaGain.observed: A separate Media audio run passed initialization, sender selection and preview. One measured virtual output level after setting -12 dB was 0.00822 versus 0.01815 at unity. The other output measured 0.00445 versus 0.01773. The fixture rejected the first ratio.

startupRecheck.scope: Latest local developer binary in the Windows bundle layout with a fresh profile. The fixture removed the configured runtime variable and attempted to redirect ProgramFiles. A later child-process check showed Windows restored ProgramFiles, so the installed search path remained available.
startupRecheck.media: Automatically selected the fixture sender and displayed the native preview. Windows reported that MapGyver loaded the app-local DLL.
startupRecheck.screen: Published picture and audio from an enabled NDI Screen. Reopening the saved project in a fresh process resumed the output.

runtimeFallbackRecheck.baseline: An isolated copy of the previous build had an invalid bundled DLL and a valid NDI_RUNTIME_DIR_V6. The Inspector showed only None while the independent sender was running.
runtimeFallbackRecheck.corrected: Windows loaded the configured DLL. NDI automatically selected the test sender and displayed its 320x240 moving preview. Both virtual routes measured about 0.249 of unity at -12 dB and went silent on mute and sender loss. Restarting the same sender resumed both routes. Physical output was disabled.
runtimeFallbackRecheck.bundledGainRecheck: The ordinary bundled multichannel fixture passed gain, mute, loss and same-name recovery plus the additional route cases. The previous gain failure remains historical and its cause is unproven.
runtimeFallbackRecheck.screenRegression: The rebuilt app published picture and audio with the bundled DLL and restored the sender and routes after restart and project reload.
runtimeFallbackRecheck.software: Strict Golden Video and MapGyver Clippy, formatting, fixture syntax and Windows build passed.

runtimeUnavailableRecheck.scope: Fresh Windows profiles in private debug-app layouts. The test left the configured runtime directory empty and used debug-only isolation of the system search paths. Earlier attempts to override ProgramFiles did not isolate the installed SDK.
runtimeUnavailableRecheck.incompatible: Both Inspectors showed the install or update message and the invalid bundled DLL diagnostic.
runtimeUnavailableRecheck.missing: Both Inspectors showed the install or update message and the missing DLL diagnostic.
runtimeUnavailableRecheck.isolation: An independent Spout receiver captured exact red then green images on the ordinary output while NDI was unavailable. Switching the affected Screen to Shared Texture cleared its warning and delivered an exact green image. Both failure cases passed with no WebView errors.
runtimeUnavailableRecheck.healthy: An app-local runtime with the system lookup disabled published NDI Screen picture and audio, then restored both after a restart and reopening the saved project.
runtimeUnavailableRecheck.software: Two Golden Video observation tests and 31 MapGyver preview tests passed. Generated contracts matched Rust. Svelte reported zero errors and warnings. Strict Clippy and the Windows build passed.

qualification: M17/1 and M17/2 remain open. Clean installation, independent LAN timing and wider lifecycle cases still need qualification.
